scope: Explicit signed expense contracts and concise selected-template notes for Ozon commission, acquiring and their SUMMARY.47 total; safe immutable single-catalog installer.
checks: Exact diff changes only version, notes and calculation_contract on B06.finance_commission_cost (3 to 4), B06.finance_acquiring_cost (1 to 2), and SUMMARY.47 (1 to 2). Purpose, steps, metrics, source bindings, requests, formulas and input policies are unchanged.

Commission contract exactly matches canonical negate(add_numbers(sales.fee.value, returns.fee.value)) and both currency_code paths. It includes the return commission rather than omitting it or summing absolute values.
Acquiring contract exactly matches canonical negate(sum_values(amount)) for services whose name is acquiring, with amount.value/currency_code. Other service categories are excluded.

Both metrics are signed=true in the canonical registry. Refund credits reduce expense; if credits exceed debits, negative calculated expense remains negative. There is no absolute-value or zero-clamping transform.

SUMMARY.47 keeps exactly the two existing dependencies. Its nested component contracts equal the leaf contracts, and sum_components adds the two calculated expenses once without another sign inversion or extra categories.
Notes use the calculated expense sign, preserve corrections/negative outcomes, support requested breakdowns, multiple values and comparisons, and prevent unknown-value zero substitution.
Missing fee fields remain unknown; an absent acquiring subset gives zero only in a complete verified services list. Period and currency checks remain required.
Exact canonical fee path/currency extraction, acquiring category/sign comparison, component equality, dependency order, patch consistency, validate_catalog and Python compilation pass.

Installer delta from approved WB stock summary installer is limited to release identity, immutable pins and source metadata. Only template_catalog.json may differ; safe hardlinks, changed inode replacement, atomic manifest, base hash revalidation, no-active-jobs guard, native preflight, process cwd, config equality and rollback are preserved.

verification.independent_local: Exact scope; actual canonical expression paths and transforms; signed registry definitions; nested component equality; dependencies; patch; validate_catalog; compile PASS.
verification.server_suite: Fresh complete 107-test pass is required by installer gate; server result not independently observed at review time.

limitations: Live model adherence and final positive expense wording require the planned exact-question acceptance retest; source review does not independently verify the live CASE108 amounts.
Unchanged hardlinked release payloads must remain immutable; future changes must replace destination inodes.
